response.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804;

assumptions.assumption: The average bytes per millisecond is the mean of the per-track ratio Bytes/Milliseconds, taken over the tracks with Bytes > 10323804. Rows with NULL Bytes are excluded by the filter. Bytes is cast to REAL to avoid integer division.

alternatives.interpretation: Ratio of totals: the sum of Bytes divided by the sum of Milliseconds across the filtered tracks, instead of the mean of per-track ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804;
